purpose: Create the smallest executable Android project and walking skeleton needed to prove the accepted one-deployable capability-sliced architecture, local-state baseline and safe redacted fixture path before product feature tasking.
success_outcome: A clean checkout can build one debug APK, run deterministic host-side foundation probes, initialize and reset an isolated local fixture, exercise a synthetic weather/provider path without a live key, and launch through one composition root while preserving the accepted slice and adapter boundaries.
anti_goals: Do not implement FT-001–FT-009 product behavior or acceptance criteria.
Do not add technical-layer slices, a shared business-data module, an event/message bus, backend/cloud/Google Services or reboot recovery.
Do not add a real API key to source, resources, logs, fixtures, screenshots or evidence.
Do not select a new dependency or change public/package/security/architecture posture without the governing operator checkpoint.

forbidden_scope: backend, cloud sync, accounts, Google Services and reboot recovery
shared storage ownership, event/message infrastructure and speculative slices
real user credentials in any source, resource, log or evidence artifact
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before adding a dependency or making a substantial UI toolkit, persistence, package/public-boundary or security-posture decision.
Stop and route to /spec-design if execution requires changing the accepted composition root, capability ownership, dependency direction, source of truth or a Foundation exit criterion.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks if the work expands into product behavior or feature-level provider/schema decisions.

constraints: Preserve one deployable Kotlin Android application and one composition root; the root wires settings, adapters, lifecycle, start and shutdown but owns no product business state.
Use the accepted capability-slice code roots and private owner persistence paths; do not create layer-centric scaffolding, a shared storage owner or an unauthorized dependency edge.
Keep provider communication redacted and fixture-backed; no live API key or live provider request is needed for Foundation.
Use deterministic, disposable state with a safe reset/cleanup path for every Foundation probe.
Exact Gradle/plugin/package/UI/persistence implementation details remain bounded to the accepted target; new dependency or material posture changes require operator confirmation.
invariants: .memory-bank/invariants.md#must: time remains the dominant display concern and local product state has one owner.
.memory-bank/invariants.md#never: no backend, Google Services, reboot recovery, event infrastructure or speculative V1 scope.
.memory-bank/contracts/local-secret-handling.md#local-api-key-handling-contract: user credentials stay local and redacted.
.memory-bank/domains/local-data.md#retention-and-cleanup: Foundation reset/fixture paths do not change product retention or create a second persistence owner.
verification_targets: REQ-000: one reproducible build/start/test/smoke path and a known resettable local state exist before product task design.
.memory-bank/architecture/system-architecture.md#AD-001: one app composition root and accepted capability-slice discovery roots are present without technical-layer or future-slice scaffolding.
.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#dependency-graph: scaffolded dependencies remain within the accepted directed graph and no consumer bypasses a provider owner.
.memory-bank/domains/local-data.md#durable-data-rules: isolated settings/timer/weather fixture state can be initialized, reloaded and safely reset.
.memory-bank/contracts/local-secret-handling.md#evidence-and-verification: synthetic credentials are absent from source, resources, logs and evidence.
.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#foundation-minimal-proof: host-side probes and target-device compatibility probe route are reproducible and redacted.
